Somachord Tunes.note: Somachord Tones appear as purple glowing orbs in Star Chart missions (requiring 4 scans per song), as quest rewards, or hidden throughout open worlds like Orb Vallis and Duviri.

Frame Fighter Fragments.note: Spawn randomly within mission tiles on the planet tied to the Warframe(s) they unlock. No fixed spot within the tileset.

Cephalon Fragments.note: Cephalon Fragments spawn as glowing blue orbs in normal Star Chart missions. Equipping Thief's Wit or Animal Instinct highlights them on your minimap. Complete 3 to 7 scans per entry to reveal hidden Ordis lore audio recordings.

Leverian Prex Cards.note: Prex Cards are hidden inside Drusus Leverian exhibits (accessed via Codex > Universe > Leverian or Warframe market pages). Level the corresponding Warframe to Rank 30 to make its Prex Card interactable.

Thousand-Year Fish.note: Thousand-Year Fish are small glass fish figurines hidden across the Plains of Eidolon. Scan all 20 to complete the codex entries and receive the Thousand-Year Fish Orbiter Decoration.

Fortuna Fragments.note: Fortuna Debt-Bond memory hashes are data hashes scattered across Corpus installations throughout Orb Vallis. Scanning all 5 for a character unlocks their full backstory and voice log in the Codex.

The Tenets.note: The Tenets are golden Parvos Granum Relief monuments found throughout remastered Corpus Ship tilesets. Interact with each relief to donate a Granum Crown and unlock the voiced Tenet of Parvos Granum.

Partnership Fragments.note: Partnership Fragments are hidden inside secret Amalgam laboratory puzzle rooms across the Jupiter Gas City tileset. Complete the multi-switch environmental puzzles to access the consoles.
